description: Resolve place names, addresses, coordinates and public Google Earth URLs into precise coordinates, place IDs, terrain elevation and available place-card details.

includeAddress.description: Add a street address when Google's suggestion results identify the same place unambiguously. Adds one lightweight request per query.
includeAddress.sectionDescription: Optional enrichment fields. Disable them for the fastest, smallest run.
includeAddress.title: Match addresses

includeElevation.description: Add terrain elevation in metres above sea level for every resolved coordinate, using Google Earth's public elevation service.
includeElevation.title: Terrain elevation

includeKml.description: Add a ready-to-import KML Placemark string to every record. Useful for opening the results in Google Earth, QGIS or other GIS tools.
includeKml.title: Generate KML

language.description: Language used for place names, descriptions and details returned by Google Earth.
language.sectionDescription: Optional language and geographic bias for search mode.
language.title: Language

maxItems.description: Global cap on the number of location records saved across all queries or URLs.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

maxResultsPerQuery.description: How many Google Earth matches to save for each search query. The default of 1 keeps the exact-name match. Raise it to collect every ranked match; the 'rank' field preserves Google's original order.
maxResultsPerQuery.title: Results per query

mode.description: Choose whether to search by text or resolve Google Earth URLs. (mode=search / mode=byUrls)
enumTitles: Search by place name or address
mode.title: Mode

searchArea.description: Optional north/south/east/west bounding box that biases Google Earth's ranking toward a region. Leave it unset to search worldwide. All four bounds are recommended; missing bounds fall back to the world.

east.description: Eastern longitude bound of the search area.
east.title: East longitude

north.description: Northern latitude bound of the search area.
north.title: North latitude

south.description: Southern latitude bound of the search area.
south.title: South latitude

west.description: Western longitude bound of the search area.
west.title: West longitude

searchArea.title: Search area (viewport)

searchQueries.description: Place names, addresses, postal codes or coordinate strings to search on Google Earth. (mode=search) Each query returns one result by default; raise 'Results per query' to collect more. Use specific queries such as 'KFC New York' for a particular branch.
searchQueries.title: Search queries

startUrls.description: Public earth.google.com/web URLs to resolve. A URL can contain a search text, a resolved view with coordinates and a data token, or both. URLs with a data token also unlock the place knowledge card (address, website, Wikipedia, photos and opening hours). (mode=byUrls)
startUrls.title: Google Earth URLs

title: Google Earth Location Coordinate Finder Input
